requirements.statement: The user picks reminder days and one time of day
A push notification is delivered at that local time on each selected day

stories.title: Pick reminder days and time
stories.user_story: As a user with a plan, I want to choose which days and time I am reminded, so that the reminder fits my routine
stories.business_value: A reminder the user chose is a reminder they do not mute

acceptance_criteria.given: the user is on the reminder screen
acceptance_criteria.then: the schedule is saved and shown back to them

business_rules: a schedule with no selected day is not a valid schedule
non_functional_requirements: settings survive reinstall and match on every device

stories.title: Reminder arrives at the chosen local time
stories.user_story: As a user with a schedule, I want the reminder to arrive at the time I picked, so that I train when I planned to
stories.business_value: Delivery is the feature; the schedule alone changes nothing
business_rules: delivery uses the device timezone at send time, not at schedule time
edge_cases: the user travels across a timezone between scheduling and delivery
non_functional_requirements: delivery respects device timezone after travel

assumptions.statement: the existing push provider integration is reused rather than replaced

cross_cutting_concerns.concern: timezone correctness affects scheduling and delivery together
